-r requirements_base.txt

# CUDA 13.2 / torch 2.11+cu130 / triton 3.6.0 dep set.
# First-version scope: torch + torchvision + triton + deep_gemm + flash_mla
# + fast_safetensors + fastsafetensors (the last two rebuilt against
# torch 2.11+cu130 and mirrored to oss://rtp-maga/0502/).
# CUDA 13 uses the RTP-patched FlashInfer 0.6.12 Python and cubin wheels. Its
# B12X CuTe DSL path needs the explicit TileIRAS and CUTLASS DSL pins below.
# Other torch-ABI-bound wheels without CUDA 13 builds remain deferred; see
# bazel/arch_select.bzl whl_deps() for the selected subset.

# Core torch stack — wheels mirrored to OSS by us; upstream is
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130/.
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/miji/0430/torch-2.11.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/miji/0430/torchvision-0.26.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl

# Triton 3.6.0 supports CUDA 13.x ptxas natively (no wrapper needed).
triton==3.6.0

# Self-built wheels against torch 2.11+cu130 with gcc-toolset-12.
# DeepGEMM ee6161b tracks nv_dev 2642b32 and includes native SM120 kernels.
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/deep_gemm/cuda13_sm120/ee6161be60445ec248cf63fced4215ba78ff9b39/deep_gemm-2.6.1%2Bee6161b.cu132-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl#sha256=4adee1e3b30e3d8db17374935c439781c5f6bb683be7fdc535e34ebe9bb0e081
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/miji/0430/flash_mla-1.0.0%2B9241ae3-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl

# rtp_kernel built from gitlab cuda_extension main@3bc0ca45
# (sm_80/90a/100a/103a/120a)
# against torch 2.11+cu130; flashinfer-dependent submodules (xqa,
# sparse_attention*, clustered_gather) are import-tolerant in this build.
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/cu13/rtp_kernel_260902/rtp_kernel-0.1.0%2B3bc0ca45.cu13-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl

# FlashInfer 0.6.9 has a known runtime bug. Use the internal 0.6.12 Python and
# cubin distributions. The cu129 JIT cache is deliberately excluded because
# its shared objects link libcudart.so.12 and libnvrtc.so.12; CUDA 13 must JIT.
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/cu129/flashinfer_260523/flashinfer_python-0.6.12rc1%2Brtp.260523-py3-none-any.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/cu129/flashinfer_260523/flashinfer_cubin-0.6.12rc1%2Brtp.260523-py3-none-any.whl

# FlashInfer's metadata requires TVM FFI, TileIRAS, and CUTLASS DSL >= 4.5.0.
# TileIRAS supplies CUDA 13 host compiler packages used by the SM120 DSL path.
apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.10
cuda-tile[tileiras]==1.3.0
nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.5.3

# DeepSeek V4 selects the TileLang HC implementation by default. Version 0.1.9
# is validated with torch 2.11+cu130; its remaining dependencies are locked.
tilelang==0.1.9

# fastsafetensors / fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130
# (originals were torch 2.1.2 + cu121).  Project name is `fast-safetensors`
# on PyPI but the import is `fast_safetensors`; both wheels installed.
# Required by --load_method fastsafetensors smoke targets.
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/0507/fast_safetensors-0.7.3%2Btorch2.11.cu130-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/0502/fastsafetensors-0.1.20%2Bali-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
# fast_safetensors rebuilt against torch 2.11+cu130.

# Pin safetensors and tabulate for parity with cu12_9 lock.
safetensors==0.7.0
mysql-connector-python
tabulate==0.9.0

# autoawq / auto_gptq / bitsandbytes / peft are torch-ABI-bound; pip will
# resolve compatible versions if available, otherwise we'll see them in
# the lock.  Drop autoawq from cuda13 (no torch 2.11 wheel yet upstream)
# and autoawq-kernels (same).
# auto_gptq      # deferred — torch 2.11 ABI rebuild needed
# autoawq        # deferred
# deep_ep        # deferred — current wheel links libcudart.so.12
# tensorrt 10.x cu12 series — drop for cuda13 (use TRT-LLM plugins via C++ side).
